description.value: Pho 777 is a family-owned Vietnamese restaurant on Russell Avenue in White Rock, serving authentic pho, bun thit nuong, and other Vietnamese dishes seven days a week. Fully licensed with beer and wine, it also features Mario's Gelati Italian ice cream served year-round. A welcoming neighbourhood spot open for dine-in, takeout, and delivery.

address.value: 15230 Russell Avenue, White Rock, BC V4B 2P6

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 69m; rack at 79m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully available and confirms the White Rock location at 15230 Russell Avenue with phone 604-385-0277 (not in OSM tags). The site explicitly states 'Take Out' and 'offer Wi-Fi while you dine at the restaurant,' supporting those amenities. No mention of bike parking, water bottle refill, washrooms, or cycling-specific infrastructure anywhere in the website text.
